# IA Builders & Engineering Pte Ltd

> Singapore's precision reinstatement contractor. We restore commercial, office, and industrial spaces to original condition at lease end. BizSafe Star and ISO 45001:2018 certified. Founded 2017.

## What We Do

Office reinstatement is the process of restoring a leased commercial space to its original condition as required by the tenancy agreement, typically at lease end. IA Builders handles the full scope: demolition, MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing), flooring, ceilings, painting, and landlord coordination.

## Services

- Office reinstatement (open-plan, executive, Grade A)
- Business park reinstatement (one-north, Changi, Science Park)
- Retail unit restoration
- Industrial facility reinstatement
- Demolition and hacking works
- MEP reinstatement (air-conditioning, electrical, fire protection, plumbing)
- Builder works (plastering, tiling, raised floors, joinery)
- Handyman services

## Pricing

- Basic work (repainting, simple dismantling): SGD $10–20/sqft
- Moderate work (partitions, electrical): SGD $20–40/sqft
- Extensive work (full MEP removal): SGD $40+/sqft
- Free on-site quote, no obligation

## Timelines

- Retail spaces: 1–2 weeks
- Small offices (under 2,000 sqft): 2–3 weeks
- Mid-sized offices (2,000–5,000 sqft): 3–5 weeks
- Large/complex spaces: 6–10 weeks
